name: astro-romana-tools
description: Tooling for the astro-romana game: procedural low-poly avatar, rocket-part, planet and Mars terrain generators, data-driven audio generator and their validators.

scripts.models: npm run models:build && npm run models:build:parts && npm run models:build:bodies && npm run models:validate && npm run web:models
scripts.terrain: npm run terrain:build && npm run terrain:validate
scripts.audio: npm run audio:build && npm run audio:validate
